summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Admin Zones separation (Business vs Infrastructure & Development). 9/9 backend tests pass (registry, /me, /assign happy & error paths, geographic-zones regression, admin smoke pages). Frontend: zone switcher renders with both tabs, Business zone shows EXACTLY 10 sections, Infrastructure zone shows EXACTLY 5, no cross-leak. All required nav items resolve (users, finance, settings) and /admin/admin-accounts loads correctly. Command-palette auto-switch works (searching 'Setări Platformă' from Business zone triggered zone switch to Infrastructure). Regression pages (/admin, /admin/marketing, /admin/demo-accounts, /admin/admin-accounts) load with no console errors; logout works. One minor conflict found between persistence and auto-switch — see backend/frontend issues below.

integration_issues.flow: Zone persistence after reload conflicts with auto-switch effect
integration_issues.issue: After clicking zone-tab-infrastructure on default /admin (where active=dashboard, a business item), localStorage.pm_admin_zone is correctly set to 'infrastructure', but on RELOAD the useEffect at AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx:702-709 keyed on [active] fires with active='dashboard' → activeSection.zone='business' → switchZone('business') → overwrites localStorage back to 'business'. Result: sidebar shows Business sections after reload even though user explicitly toggled Infrastructure. Review-request item #3 (persist across reload via localStorage) therefore fails for the toggle-only case. Item #6 (auto-switch on deep-link to another zone) still works — as verified by Cmd+K → 'Setări Platformă' which correctly switched to Infrastructure. Suggested fix: only auto-switch when the active item was set via navigation (deep-link/palette), not on initial mount, OR change the effect to only run when 'active' actually changes (skip first render) so the persisted zone wins on cold-load.

action_items: Decide the priority between zone persistence (localStorage) vs auto-switch on active-item change. The current useEffect at AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx line 702-709 unconditionally overrides localStorage on every mount because active is populated at first render. Simplest fix: gate the effect with a ref that skips the first render so the persisted zone wins on cold-load, while deep-link/Cmd+K navigations (which set active AFTER mount) still auto-switch. Everything else in the review request works as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx:702-709 — useEffect keyed only on [active] runs on mount; because active is populated during the first render, it overrides the persisted zone from localStorage on every cold reload. Add a first-render guard (useRef) or key the effect off a genuine navigation event.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the persistence-vs-auto-switch conflict: In AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx the useEffect at lines 702-709 is keyed on [active]. React runs it once on mount with the initial active prop (typically 'dashboard'). It then looks up which section owns that item ('dashboard' → business zone) and unconditionally calls switchZone('business') → setStoredZone('business'), overwriting whatever the user persisted. Reproduction: (1) login as super-admin, (2) go to /admin, (3) click [data-testid='zone-tab-infrastructure'], (4) verify localStorage.pm_admin_zone==='infrastructure', (5) hard reload — sidebar now shows Business sections and localStorage flips back to 'business'. Mitigation: add a useRef first-render guard, e.g. `const didMount = useRef(false); useEffect(() => { if (!didMount.current) { didMount.current = true; return; } /* existing auto-switch */ }, [active]);`. This preserves auto-switch on genuine navigation (Cmd+K, deep-link clicks after mount) while letting the persisted zone win on initial load.
